Use with caution / monitor [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1].

Potassium-sparing diuretics such as spironolactone can increase the risk of hyperkalemia when used concomitantly with lisinopril [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1]. ACE inhibitors and potassium-sparing agents both affect potassium levels, and combining them requires frequent monitoring of the patient's serum potassium [lisinopril:drug_interactions:1, spironolactone:drug_interactions:1].
